item.title: Top 15 Ways to Practice Body Love Before Your Photoshoot
item.description: To prepare for a photoshoot is like “a celebration of you.” It is an opportunity to capture your unique essence and beauty. It’s a journey that is all about cultivating authentic and deep appreciation for yourself and your body, just as it is at that time. Based on the expert advice, here are the top 15 practices that are designed to nourish your confidence—inside-out. To follow it will ensure you are empowered as well as radiant in front of the lens on the day of photoshoot.
